other_conditions: Applicant must have passed the 12th standard or higher.
For a new start‑up, the youth must be unemployed and registered with the District Employment and Counseling Center.
For expansion of an existing business, the applicant must have been operating the business for at least two years.
Non‑individual enterprises must have at least 51% shareholding and controlling stake held by one entrepreneur who meets the above criteria.
Each individual can seek assistance under the scheme only once.
At least 25% of the cases in a financial year are reserved for women applicants.
benefits_summary: Start‑up loan of ₹2 Lakhs to ₹20 Lakhs with interest up to ₹2 Lakhs; no margin money required and only the principal amount needs to be repaid by the applicant.
